values.meaning: damage reduction while Void Shift is active
duration Void Shift lingers before expiring after triggering condition

mechanics.claim: Void Shift grants crowd control immunity and massive damage reduction until Malzahar takes non-minion damage or negates a crowd control effect.
mechanics.quote: '''Malzahar''' gains {{tip|Cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} and 90% damage reduction

mechanics.claim: Void Shift does not mitigate true damage but the buff is still consumed.
mechanics.quote: ''Void Shift'' will not mitigate {{tip|true damage}} but the buff will still be consumed.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown before Void Shift becomes available again refreshes whenever Malzahar takes non-minion damage or is affected by a crowd control effect, and resets on respawn.
mechanics.quote: ''Void Shift's'' {{sti|cooldown}} refreshes whenever '''Malzahar''' takes non-{{tip|minion}} damage or is affected by a {{tip|crowd control}} effect, and resets upon [[death|respawning]].

mechanics.claim: Shields take priority over Void Shift, and the buff is always consumed even if the shield fully mitigates the damage.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Shield|Shields}} will take priority over ''Void Shift'', but the buff is always consumed, even if the shield fully mitigates the damage.
